parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: An RFC 9651 String, so quoted, such as "8e03978e-40d5-43e8-bc93-6894a57f9324": 1 to 255 printable characters once decoded. One key per raise attempt; resend the same key to retry it.

ActorType.description: Who acted, as events and operations see it (AD-19): `customer`, `operations` or `automation`.

AntiforgeryResponse.description: The body of `GET /api/v1/bff/antiforgery`: the value the SPA sends in the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header.

DisputeAction.description: A named change to a dispute. On the wire: `raise`, `startReview`, and so on.

DisputePageResponse.description:
The body of `GET /api/v1/disputes` (AD-5): one page, newest first. Pass `nextCursor` back as
`cursor` for the next page; it is null on the last page.

DisputeResponse.description:
A dispute as its customer sees it (AD-13): no actor identity, SLA or due date. `outcome` is `upheld` or
`rejected` once the dispute is resolved, and null until then. `expectedAmount` is set only for the reason
`wrongAmount`; `disputedAmount` is then the transaction amount minus it.

DisputeStatus.description: A dispute's internal status, as events and operations see it. Customers see CustomerStatus instead.

DisputeSummaryResponse.description:
One row of the customer's history list (AD-13): the dispute without its note, expected amount or timeline, which
the detail carries. `outcome` is `upheld` or `rejected` once the dispute is resolved, and null until then.

Money.description: An amount on the wire (AD-4): a decimal string with exactly two decimals, such as `849.00`, and its ISO 4217 code.

OperationsDisputeResponse.description:
A dispute as operations see it (FR-30): the internal status, the outcome (null until resolved), the reason, the
stored transaction snapshot, the amounts and the timeline of every stored event. No note the customer wrote, no
customer ID and no actor identity.

OperationsTimelineEntryResponse.description:
One stored event as operations see it (FR-30): its type, who acted (the actor type, never the identity), when, and
the statuses it moved between. `fromStatus` is null on `disputeRaised` and `slaWarningRaised`, and
`toStatus` on `slaWarningRaised`. `note` is set only on `disputeResolved`: the bank's note
meant for the customer.

accountRef.description: The transaction's `accountRef` from the transactions list, 1 to 32 characters.

oneOf.description: Why the customer disputes the transaction.

note.description: Optional, at most 1,000 characters (UTF-16 code units) after trimming.

expectedAmount.description:
The amount the customer expected to pay, in ZAR, as a decimal string such as `80.00`: required for the reason
`wrongAmount` and rejected for every other reason; at least 0.00, at most 2 decimals, and below the
transaction amount.

RaiseDisputeRequest.description:
The body of `POST /api/v1/disputes` (FR-13). Built-in minimal API validation checks its shape before the
transaction is looked up (AD-8), so each rule here is one a body breaks on its own; rules that need the transaction
(disputability, an expected amount below the transaction amount) come after the lookup. Any other property, such as
an amount, date or description, is ignored.

Reason.description: Why the customer disputes a transaction. On the wire: `unrecognised`, `duplicateCharge`, and so on.

oneOf.description: Required: `upheld` or `rejected`, exactly; any other spelling, `Upheld` included, fails to bind.

note.description: Required: the note meant for the customer, 1 to 500 characters (UTF-16 code units) after trimming; stored trimmed.

ResolveDisputeRequest.description:
The body of `POST /api/v1/operations/disputes/{disputeId}/resolve` (FR-23). Both fields are checked after the
dispute is loaded, so an unknown dispute gets 404 before a missing outcome or a bad note gets 400 (AD-8). Any other
property is ignored.

SessionState.description: Where the caller stands (AD-10): not signed in, signed in but not yet a linked customer, or linked.

idNumber.description: The South African ID number: exactly 13 ASCII digits, the last being the Luhn check digit of the first 12.

accountNumber.description: One of the customer's bank account numbers: 6 to 16 ASCII digits.

StartLinkingRequest.description:
The body of `POST /api/v1/linking/start` (FR-4). Built-in minimal API validation checks its format; neither
value is trimmed or normalised, and any other property, such as a cellphone number, is ignored. A message never
repeats the value (AD-3).

StoredEventType.description: The type of a stored event on an operations timeline: the closed set of AD-14a, camelCase on the wire.

TimelineActor.description: Who acted, as the customer sees it (AD-13): the customer, or the bank for operations and automation.

TimelineEntryResponse.description: One timeline entry as the customer sees it: the action, the status it led to, who acted, when, and any note meant for the customer.

TransactionDirection.description: Whether money left the account or arrived in it.

TransactionKind.description: What kind of movement a transaction is.

TransactionPageResponse.description:
The body of `GET /api/v1/transactions` (AD-5): one page, newest first. Pass `nextCursor` back as
`cursor` for the next page; it is null on the last page.

TransactionResponse.description:
One row of `GET /api/v1/transactions`. The account shows only its last 4 digits and the card only its first 6
and last 4 (`maskedCard` is null when there is no card). `notDisputableReason` is null
exactly when `disputable` is true. `disputeId` and `customerStatus` name the transaction's dispute,
in any status, and are both null when it has none.

TransactionSnapshotResponse.description: The disputed transaction as core banking reported it when the dispute was raised.

TransactionState.description: Whether a transaction has settled or is still pending.

code.description: The OTP from the SMS: exactly six ASCII digits, leading zeros included.

VerifyOtpRequest.description:
The body of `POST /api/v1/linking/verify` (FR-5). Built-in minimal API validation checks its format; the code is
not trimmed, and any other property is ignored. No field names a challenge or a customer: verification acts only on
the login's current challenge. A message never repeats the value (AD-3).

note.description: Optional, at most 500 characters (UTF-16 code units) after trimming. Absent, null, empty or only whitespace means no note.

WithdrawDisputeRequest.description:
The body of `POST /api/v1/disputes/{disputeId}/withdraw` (FR-18). The note is checked after the dispute is
loaded, so an unknown dispute gets 404 before a note too long gets 400 (AD-8). Any other property is ignored.
